title: Sidecar Workspace Orchestration & Route Affordance Study
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: define a compact, role-aware navigation pattern that surfaces workspace switching, rollout controls, and cost dashboards without overwhelming the main rail. We propose a primary slim left rail with essential routes and a contextual right-side "sidecar" panel that unfolds workspace-specific controls: quick-switch, recent routes, active rollouts, cost summary, and link to the full Console page. The sidecar should be lightweight (animated slide-in), keyboard-accessible, and cache-aware so expensive fetches for cost/rollout state are deferred until the panel is visible. This ticket contains prototype sketches, interaction specs, constraints from backend/infra, and a pilot QA checklist for a staged rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Primary left rail reduced to top-level routes: Dashboard, Models, Deployments, Monitor, Settings
Sidecar exposes workspace switcher, recent routes (max 6), active rollouts summary, and cost delta badge
Keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+K then W) opens sidecar and focuses search
Sidecar analytics events emitted for open/close and CTA clicks
Accessibility: sidecar meets WCAG 2.1 AA focus order and has aria-live for cost updates
Prototype validated with PM and two eng owners and one security review sign-off
tasks: Design: high-fidelity Figma prototype for desktop and 1200px breakpoint - Aisha
Eng: feasibility review for lazy-loading cost/rollout APIs and event hooks - Priya Sharma
PM: define telemetry events and SLO for sidecar fetches - Jonah Ellis
Design: small-device behavior and collapsed rail patterns - Mariana Gomez
QA: accessibility audit and keyboard nav test plan - Maya Lin
decisions: Adopt sidecar pattern instead of expanding primary rail to avoid occluding content
Delay embedding detailed cost breakdowns inside sidecar; surface a compact badge with link to full cost view
Default workspace switcher shows 8 most recent workspaces and a 'Pin' affordance for quick access
Use progressive enhancement: show cached rollout snapshots immediately, then reconcile with live fetch when available
comments: 2025-02-15 - Liam O'Connor: Reviewed low-fi flows. Agrees with sidecar but wants clear escape (Esc closes) and persistent keyboard focus. Asked design to show animation timing values.

2025-02-18 - Priya Sharma (Engineering): Backend note - rollout and cost APIs are rate-limited; recommend batching and caching layer. We'll need a new 'sidecar-summary' endpoint to avoid multiple calls on open.

2025-02-20 - Jonah Ellis (PM): Requesting telemetry spec: open, close, switch-workspace, click-rollout, click-cost-link, pin-workspace. Also propose gradual rollout: 10% of orgs in Beta with a flag in console-2025.03.
2025-02-24 - Maya Lin (Accessibility): Sidecar must trap focus while open and restore focus to invoking element. Provide aria-describedby for cost badges and role-based labels for workspace pins.

2025-02-28 - Design review notes: Reduced iconography in primary rail to single-line icons with tooltips. Sidecar will use a two-column layout: left quick-list, right details pane (collapsible on narrow screens).
2025-03-03 - Security review: Sidecar will not fetch sensitive audit logs by default; any access to audit-level data requires an elevated permission check and explicit consent modal.
next_steps: Finalize Figma screens and handoff tokens for motion (duration 220ms ease-out)
Eng to prototype sidecar-summary endpoint and return a mock payload for design QA
Schedule a 60-minute cross-functional review the week of 2025-03-10
Prepare a Beta rollout plan and toggle for 10% orgs with telemetry enabled
